title: BECE English Studies: Vocabulary & Register - English Studies - Register
subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

The constitution of the country was formally ________ by the newly elected lawmakers to include human rights protections.
questions.explain: In government and legal contexts (formal register), official changes made to a constitution or law are referred to as 'amendments'; hence, the document is 'amended'.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

In the school disciplinary code, a student who regularly stays away from school without permission is classified as a ________.
questions.explain: In an educational register, 'truant' is the precise term used for a pupil who stays away from school without leave or explanation.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

During the legislative debate, the minority leader attempted to delay the passage of the controversial bill by launching a lengthy ________.
questions.explain: In parliamentary and government registers, a 'filibuster' is a formal procedure where debate over a proposed piece of legislation is extended to delay or entirely prevent a vote.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

All newly admitted undergraduate students were required to swear a solemn oath of good academic conduct during the formal ________ ceremony.
questions.explain: 'Matriculation' is the specific formal register used in higher education environments for the ceremony marking a student's formal entrance into a university.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

Leading health demographers have officially recorded a magnificent decline in maternal ________ over the last decade, primarily crediting superior prenatal healthcare initiatives.
questions.explain: 'Maternal mortality' is the precise register used in demographic and medical contexts to denote the death rate of women related to pregnancy or childbirth.
questions.subject: English Studies
